description: Defines internal structures, types, and functions for the FreeType glyph loader, including glyph loader structures, subglyphs, and related operations.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_New
methods.description: Creates a new empty glyph loader.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_CreateExtra
methods.description: Adds an extra points table to a glyph loader.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_Reset
methods.description: Resets a glyph loader, freeing all internal data.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_CheckPoints
methods.description: Checks if there is enough space to add points and contours.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_CheckSubGlyphs
methods.description: Checks if there is enough space to add sub-glyphs.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a glyph loader by emptying the current glyph.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_Add
methods.description: Adds the current glyph to the base glyph.

methods.name: FT_GlyphLoader_CopyPoints
methods.description: Copies points from one glyph loader to another.
